tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground (first stop of the body gradient). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: color-rich-black
tokens.usage: Depth, sophistication, film emulsion darkness. Used as text on `.btn-primary`, `.btn-primary:hover`, `.btn-secondary:hover`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-pure-white
tokens.usage: Clarity, silver screen brightness, spotlights. Used as text on `h2`, `a:hover`, `.card-title`. 19.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-velvet-red
tokens.usage: Passion, drama, theater curtains, premiere glamour.

tokens.name: color-hollywood-gold
tokens.usage: Prestige, awards, marquee lights, luxury. Used as text on `h1`, `a`, `.logo`; border on `.nav a:hover`; shadow/glow on `.status-active`, `.section-title::after`. 9.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-cream
tokens.usage: Aged film stock, vintage paper, soft highlights. Used as text on `h3`, `label`. 17.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-background
tokens.usage: Depth, sophistication, film emulsion darkness. Used as background on `body`.

tokens.name: color-text-primary
tokens.usage: Clarity, silver screen brightness, spotlights. Used as text on `body`. 19.0:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Aged film stock, vintage paper, soft highlights. Used as text on `p`, `.stat-label`, `.card-description`. 17.6:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-accent-primary
tokens.usage: Prestige, awards, marquee lights, luxury. Used as shadow/glow on `.nav a:hover`, `input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus`; background on `.stat-card::before`, `tbody tr:hover`.

tokens.name: color-accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Passion, drama, theater curtains, premiere glamour.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Prestige, awards, marquee lights, luxury. Used as shadow/glow on `.nav a:hover`, `input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus`; background on `.stat-card::before`, `tbody tr:hover`.
